body:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

```python
import torch

a = torch.rand(4, requires_grad=True)

b = a.view(4)
assert b.requires_grad and b._is_view()

with torch.no_grad():
    c = b.view(4)

assert c.requires_grad

class View(torch.autograd.Function):
    @staticmethod
    def forward(ctx, x):
        # return x.data.view(x.shape)
        return x.detach().view(x.shape)

    @staticmethod
    def backward(ctx, grad):
        return grad

d = View.apply(a)
assert d.requires_grad and d._is_view()

with torch.no_grad():
    e = d.view(4)

assert e.requires_grad # AssertionError
```

The variable `d` in the `forward` method of other `autograd.Function` implementations may behave differently compared to `b`. But I don’t have any method to distinguish between them.

### Versions

Versions of relevant libraries:
